description: Add, replace, or mix an audio track into an existing video and render a new output file. Returns JSON {success, output_path}. Use to score or re-voice a video; source video and audio are read only. Pass video_path as the source video and audio_path as the audio file; set mix to combine or false to replace.

audio_path.description: Absolute path to an existing local audio file such as MP3, WAV, M4A, or AAC.
audio_path.title: Audio Path

duration_policy.description: How to reconcile audio and video length: keep_video (default, preserves the full video/outro), pad_audio, loop_audio, trim_audio, or shortest (may trim the outro).
duration_policy.title: Duration Policy

fade_in.description: Non-negative fade-in duration in seconds applied to the inserted audio.
fade_in.title: Fade In

fade_out.description: Non-negative fade-out duration in seconds applied near the inserted audio end.
fade_out.title: Fade Out

mix.description: True mixes the new audio with existing video audio; false replaces the original audio track.
mix.title: Mix

output_path.description: Destination video path. Auto-generated when omitted; an existing supplied path may be overwritten.
output_path.title: Output Path

start_time.description: Optional start offset in seconds where the inserted audio begins.
start_time.title: Start Time

video_path.description: Absolute path to an existing local video file. The input file is read only.
video_path.title: Video Path

volume.description: Audio gain from 0.0 to 2.0, where 1.0 preserves original loudness.
volume.title: Volume

name: video_add_audio
title: Add or mix video audio
